name: Meeting room sign
description: A door sign for a meeting room: a huge green AVAILABLE or red BUSY band, the current and next meeting, and today's agenda, from any Calendar (iCal) data source. Privacy mode shows "Reserved" instead of titles. Made for a portrait panel beside the door, and works landscape or as a strip too.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: calendar
params.label: Room calendar (Calendar / iCal data source)
params.help: A Calendar data source pointed at the room's iCal feed (Google, Outlook/Exchange, any .ics URL). Without one, a sample schedule is shown.

params.name: available_label
params.label: Available text
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the sign's language.

params.name: busy_label
params.label: Busy text
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the sign's language.

params.name: hide_titles
params.label: Privacy: hide meeting titles and organisers

params.name: reserved_label
params.label: Text shown instead of a hidden title
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the sign's language.

params.name: now_label
params.label: Heading: current meeting
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the sign's language.

params.name: next_label
params.label: Heading: next meeting
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the sign's language.

params.name: agenda_label
params.label: Heading: today's agenda
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the sign's language.

params.name: upcoming_label
params.label: Heading: later bookings (when nothing is left today)
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the sign's language.

params.name: empty_label
params.label: Text when nothing is booked
params.help: Leave empty for the built-in word in the sign's language.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Clock timezone
params.help: Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The sign's words, dates and times, e.g. en-GB or de-DE. Empty = the screen's language. Calendar times and status are shown in it too; give the calendar the same timezone as the clock.
